title: Lululemon Mirror Will Not Power On
shortDescription: Mirror display stays dark when plugged in.
fullDescription: The Mirror's brick power supply is the most common point of failure. A dead Mirror is usually solved by power-cycling the brick or replacing it. Wall outlet on a switched circuit is also a common cause.

fixSteps.title: Try another outlet
fixSteps.instruction: Plug into a known-live outlet, not a switched one.

fixSteps.title: Inspect brick
fixSteps.instruction: Check that the LED on the AC adapter is lit; if not, request replacement.

whenToCallPro: Lululemon Studio support handles RMA if a new brick doesn't help.

faq.a: Lululemon discontinued Mirror; existing units retain support and content access on grandfathered subscriptions.

title: Mirror Companion App Crashes on Open
shortDescription: Lululemon Studio (formerly Mirror) app force-closes immediately.
fullDescription: After the Lululemon Studio rebrand, some users on older OS versions experience app crashes. Reinstalling and ensuring iOS 16+/Android 12+ resolves most cases.

fixSteps.title: Update OS
fixSteps.instruction: Update phone to latest iOS or Android.

fixSteps.title: Reinstall app
fixSteps.instruction: Delete and reinstall Lululemon Studio app.

title: Mirror Plays Class but No Sound
shortDescription: Video runs, but speakers are silent.
fullDescription: Audio is routed to internal speakers by default but can also pair to Bluetooth earbuds. If sound is missing, an audio routing bug or muted volume is usually to blame.

fixSteps.title: Check Bluetooth
fixSteps.instruction: Forget any paired Bluetooth speakers/earbuds in Mirror settings.

fixSteps.title: Restart
fixSteps.instruction: Hold power button for 10 seconds to reboot.

whenToCallPro: Call support if speakers fail after reboot — internal hardware repair.

title: Mirror Glass Cracked or Damaged
shortDescription: Visible crack in the reflective glass.
fullDescription: The Mirror's tempered glass is repairable only by Lululemon Studio service. Continuing to use a cracked unit is unsafe.

fixSteps.title: File claim
fixSteps.instruction: Contact Lululemon Studio support; out-of-warranty replacement is paid.

title: Mirror Class Stutters or Buffers
fullDescription: Mirror requires 10 Mbps for HD streaming. Buffering points to a slow Wi-Fi connection or a router placement issue.

fixSteps.title: Speed test
fixSteps.instruction: Run a speed test from your phone next to Mirror — confirm >10 Mbps.

title: Mirror 1:1 Trainer Session Camera Not Working
shortDescription: Trainer reports they can't see you on camera during a 1:1 class.
fullDescription: Mirror has an internal camera covered by a privacy slider. If the trainer can't see you, the privacy cover may be closed or app permissions revoked.

fixSteps.title: Open privacy cover
fixSteps.instruction: Slide the camera cover above the screen.

fixSteps.title: Re-enable camera
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Privacy > Allow camera for 1:1 trainer.

faq.a: Lululemon Studio retains 1:1 personal training during transition.

title: Mirror Software Update Failed
shortDescription: Update progress freezes or rolls back.
fullDescription: Updates require a stable Wi-Fi connection. Interrupted updates either resume or roll back; persistent failures may need a remote reset by support.

fixSteps.title: Retry over strong Wi-Fi
fixSteps.instruction: Move closer to router or use mesh node.

whenToCallPro: Contact Lululemon Studio if rollback persists.

faq.a: Lululemon committed to security updates through 2025-2026.

title: Mirror Heart Rate Strap Loses Connection
fullDescription: Mirror supports Bluetooth heart rate straps. Drops are typically caused by low strap battery, sweat-impaired contacts, or interference.

fixSteps.title: Wet contacts
fixSteps.instruction: Moisten the inside of the strap before wearing.

faq.a: Most Bluetooth Smart HR straps including Polar H10 and Wahoo TICKR.

title: Mirror Stuck on Lululemon Logo
shortDescription: Boot screen shows logo and never proceeds.
fullDescription: Boot loops are caused by interrupted updates, corrupted storage, or main board issues. A factory reset usually resolves software-related boot loops.

fixSteps.title: Hold reset
fixSteps.instruction: Hold the recovery button on the back for 30 seconds to enter recovery mode.

fixSteps.title: Factory reset
fixSteps.instruction: Select Factory Reset in recovery; reconnect Wi-Fi after.

whenToCallPro: Lululemon Studio support if recovery fails.

faq.a: Local data only — class history is in cloud.

title: Mirror Top Edge Hot to Touch
shortDescription: Heat from top vent during long sessions.
fullDescription: Mirror dissipates heat through the top vent. Some warmth is normal, but excessive heat after short use indicates a blocked vent or fan failure.

fixSteps.title: Clear vent
fixSteps.instruction: Ensure 4 inches of clearance above the Mirror.

whenToCallPro: If shutdown persists, the internal fan may need service replacement.

faq.a: Yes — top edge can run 35-40 C in normal operation.
